sentences.text: Heard Mr. P.C. Jena, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. S. Nayak, learned counsel for the Republic of India (CBI).
2. The petitioner is an accused in connection with SPE No.4 of 2009, pending before the Court of the learned Special C.J.M., CBI, Bhubaneswar, arising out of CBI Bhubaneswar SPE.
Case No.1 of 2009 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 420/471 of IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Special CJM, CBI, Bhubaneswar by order dated 15.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the petitioner was released on bail by order dated 22.05.2009 by the learned Special Judge and since he did not appear on the date fixed, NBW(A) was issued pursuant to which he was taken into custody on 11.05.2023.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that non-appearance on the date fixed was for reasons beyond the control of the petitioner and because of communication gap between the petitioner and his counsel.
6. Mr. Nayak, learned counsel for the CBI submits that the petitioner is in the habit of not respecting Sanjay Behera vs Republic Of India (Cbi) ....

1 the orders passed by the learned Court and because of his past conduct, he ought not to be shown any leniency and because of his non-appearance, the trial is unnecessarily lingering.
7. On a conspectus of the materials on record, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
8. Additionally, it is directed that petitioner shall appear before the I.O. of the CBI once every week on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.

9. It is further directed that in addition to the sureties so fixed, one of the sureties shall be an immediate member of the family of the Petitioner, who shall execute the P.R bond.
10.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rules.
